hotel.name: Bruce Bowker's Carib Inn
points: Small waterfront dive inn, Google 4.9 (100 reviews, via bonaire.com)
Daily boat trips 8:30 AM and 1:30 PM (north/south sites + Klein Bonaire)
Guest-only rentals: compact truck $490/week, compact car $294/week (1-week minimum)
House reef / shore entry not confirmed on the official site, so ask at check-in

checklist.t: Passports valid at least 6 months past travel

checklist.note: Pay at the official site about 7 days before. Card only. Avoid reseller sites.

checklist.t: STINAPA Nature Fee: $40 per person, per calendar year
checklist.note: Required for any water contact (dive, snorkel, swim), plus Washington Slagbaai park entry. Valid Jan 1–Dec 31 of the purchase year.
Atlantic hurricane season runs Jun 1–Nov 30. Bonaire is south of the main belt, but cover is still worth it.

checklist.t: Book the rental pickup, with a tank rack
checklist.note: Pickup + tanks is how Bonaire shore diving works. See Info → Getting around.

checklist.t: Type 2 → NACS adapter: only if bringing an EV (we're not)

checklist.note: Mineral zinc/titanium only in the marine park. No oxybenzone/octinoxate.

checklist.t: Book the mandatory orientation dive for day 1
checklist.note: Required for everyone new to Bonaire before independent shore diving.
